g.text: e6: measured recovery versus extra HBM allocation
Exploratory: single observations; no confidence intervals. 4 route aliases excluded from sample counts.
Fixed DRAM base: 65.50 GiB. Extra HBM is page-rounded accounting; physical high-water is not asserted.
